PageCanvas coordinates a page-id-scoped signal session, tab/page-scoped coordinator, measurements and runtime slots. Runtime slot/width/auto-height modules already own sub-responsibilities. The page change clears measurement epochs and creates a fresh batch, while block changes update the retained coordinator instead of disposing active sessions. The coordinator lifetime is tab/page/sharedCoordinator/signalSession; a following updateBlocks effect reconciles changing runtime blocks. The editor copies committed settings into an isolated draft. Edits must remain staged until Save and be discarded on cancel, so displaying a live derivation of props would lose the edit buffer.

The settings, column and action editors own unsaved form values while open. They start from committed settings but apply edits only through the save paths; live prop projection would overwrite staged values.
The edited search string filters the already loaded eligible data models by title and code. A ref would not rerender the menu results; the catalog queries themselves remain scoped to the opened menu.
